To get the exact value, look up A001035 and check the term at index 19, or implement a verified recurrence (for example, one from the OEIS entry) in a script and test it against the known small terms 1, 1, 3, 19, 219, 4231 before running it for n = 19.

ANSWER: Not determined; the value is a(19) of OEIS A001035, which I could not reliably compute or recall.
